cossack-hetmanate: ottoman-empire (me-10) has gain/loss of Podolia against the Commonwealth (1672, 1699) and a 1677 loss to zaporozhian-cossacks of right-bank Ukraine; it has no occupation or protectorate of this state's right bank (Hetmanate infobox: right bank 'protectorate of the Ottoman Empire' 1669-1685), so the 1672 occupation_start here has no mirrored event.

cossack-hetmanate: tsardom-of-russia has a 1654 vassal_start for this state and no vassal_end; russian-empire has no 1764 event for the left bank; zaporozhian-cossacks has no 1686/1709 events naming the hetman.

cossack-hetmanate: the drawn left bank (about 104,000 km2) is half the infobox 208,000 km2 and both banks (about 226,000 km2) are 0.73 of 312,000; the page gives no method and Kursk and Bryansk are deliberately not restored.

principality-of-yaroslavl: principality-of-vladimir-suzdal's 1389 loss to this state is a confidence-1 carving device (eu-16-g should make it a note); Rostov and Uglich lands cut out here have no dossier of their own.
Sloboda Ukraine (Cliopatria, from 1670) is subtracted from Sumy oblast in every Hetmanate region; the Cliopatria shape is used for all years 1649-1764, an approximation before 1670.
